item.title: Ibrahim Gambari, ex-chief of staff to Buhari, appointed visiting scholar at University of Pennsylvania
item.description: Ibrahim Gambari, a former foreign affairs minister and diplomat, has been appointed a distinguished visiting scholar at the Center for Africana Studies, University of Pennsylvania, US. The appointment was announced by the Savannah Centre for Diplomacy, Democracy and Development (SCDDD), an Abuja-based non-governmental organisation founded by Gambari. item.title: Trump asks Australian PM to grant asylum to Iranian women’s football team after anthem protest
item.description: US President Donald Trump has called on Australia to grant asylum to members of Iran’s national women’s football team, claiming the players could face danger if they return home. item.description: The State Department warned Monday of a threat to US facilities and schools in Nigeria, urging Americans to take precautions. “The US embassy in Abuja informs US citizens of a possible terrorist threat against US facilities and US affiliated schools in Nigeria,” it said in a notice. “Increasing awareness of your surroundings, avoiding predictable routines, and reviewing general security precautions with your family can help reduce your risk,” it said. item.title: Forbes’ billionaires list: Dangote, Rabiu on the rise, Adenuga, Otedola make list again
item.description: Aliko Dangote, the founder of Dangote Group, has retained his position as Africa’s richest man, as the combined wealth of the continent’s billionaires rose to $126.7 billion. According to the latest ranking by Forbes, the fortunes of Africa’s 23 billionaires increased by $20.3 billion over the past year. The report said the figure represents a 21 percent rise from 2025.
